name: Table
summary: Tabular data: many items sharing the same attributes.

rows.description: Array of row objects in host data

caption.description: What the table shows (required for accessibility)

kind.description: What the cell holds; drives alignment, tabular figures and status tags

align.description: Overrides the alignment the kind implies

sortable.description: Whether people can sort by this column

avatarPath.description: For 'entity': relative path to the picture or initials

secondaryPath.description: For 'entity': a second line, e.g. an email address

rowAction.description: Activated per row; context bindings resolve against the row

empty.description: Status component shown when there are no rows

column.description: Key of the sorted column in host data

action.description: Sent when someone sorts, so the host can re-query

sort.description: Sorting state, owned by the host

selection.description: 'multiple' adds a checkbox column and a select-all

selected.description: Array of selected row values in host data

rowValuePath.description: Relative path to each row's id, used for selection

bulkActions.description: ActionBar shown instead of the toolbar while rows are selected

rowActions.description: ActionBar offered per row, in a menu named after the row

toolbar.description: ActionBar above the table (e.g. New, Import, Export)

views.description: Saved views (All, Mine, Past due…), shown as tabs with counts

view.description: Key of the selected saved view in host data

total.description: Total number of rows, all pages

action.description: Sent when someone changes page or page size

page.description: Paging state, owned by the host

whenToUse: Scanning or comparing many rows by several attributes
Records people scan, sort, select and act on in bulk (B2B lists)
whenNotToUse: A few entities where the user must choose: use Comparison

accessibility.role: table with caption and column headers
requirements: Column headers are real header cells
Numeric columns are right-aligned by format
Sortable headers carry aria-sort and say what sorting does
The select-all checkbox is mixed when some rows are selected
The bulk-action bar names how many rows are selected, announced politely
Each row's action menu is named after its row

agent: Read by row and column headers; rows with rowAction are activatable. Sort by activating a column header; select rows by their checkboxes; act in bulk from the bar that appears.
rendering: On compact screens, rows become stacked cards with label/value pairs
Alignment follows the column format, never chosen by the model
Numbers and currency are right-aligned with tabular figures; 'status' renders as a tag using 'tones'
On compact surfaces the table becomes a list of rows: the entity, the key fields in one line, and the status
Selection replaces the toolbar with the bulk-action bar while rows are selected
Paging shows rows per page, the range and the total

mappings.web: shadcn Table (optionally Data Table with TanStack)
mappings.ios: Table on regular width; List of rows on compact width
mappings.android: LazyColumn of rows with a header row (no built-in M3 table)

a2ui: No direct equivalent; exports as List of Row
